title: WSPerson
description: JSON Schema for the WSPerson object returned by the UWA Profiles and Research Repository (Elsevier Pure Web Service 524).

costCenters.description: Only available on the DK and UK bases

gender.description: Only available if it is made public

dateOfBirth.description: Only available if it is made public

profiled.description: Only available when the Author Profile module is enabled

leavesOfAbsence.description: Only available when the proper configuration is enabled

affiliationNote.description: Only available when the proper configuration is enabled

professionalQualifications.description: Only available when the proper configuration is enabled

fieldOfResearchAssociations.description: Only available when the ERA module is enabled

willTakePhdStudents.description: Only available when the proper configuration is enabled

phdResearchProjects.description: Only available when the proper configuration is enabled

privateAddress.description: Only available when the proper configuration is enabled

personExpertise.description: Only available when the Person Expertise module is enabled
